data.name: Eimam
data.gender_notes: Eimam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘imamah’ meaning ‘leadership’. In Islamic context, an imam is a religious leader and the prayer leader in a mosque. The name Eimam is a fitting choice for a boy destined to become a leader or a religious figure. The name Eimam carries the meaning “Leader, Guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Eimam usually hope their child will grow to embody leader, guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Eimam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Leader, Guide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eimam total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: إمام
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإمام هو القائد أو الزعيم الديني الذي يقود الناس في الصلاة والشؤون الدينية، ويتمتع بسلطة روحية وسياسية، ويرجع أصل الكلمة إلى الجذر العربي أَمَمَ الذي يعني القدوة أو التوجيه

in_urdu.name: امام
in_urdu.long_meaning: امام وہ مذہبی رہنما ہے جو لوگوں کی نماز اور مذہبی معاملات کی قیادت کرتا ہے، اور مذہبی اور سیاسی دونوں طور پر اثر و رسوخ رکھتا ہے، اور اس کا تعلق عربي جڑھ اَمَمَ سے ہے جو راہ دکھانے یا قیادت کرنے کا معنی دیتا ہے

in_hindi.name: इमाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: इमाम वह धार्मिक नेता है जो लोगों की प्रार्थना और धार्मिक मामलों का नेतृत्व करता है, और धार्मिक और राजनीतिक दोनों तरह से प्रभाव रखता है, और इसका संबंध अरबी मूल اَمَمَ से है जो मार्गदर्शन या नेतृत्व करने का अर्थ देता है

in_pashto.name: امام
in_pashto.long_meaning: امام دا چې ديني مشر دی چې خلکو د لمونځ او ديني چارو کی قیادت کوي، او ديني او سياسي دواړو لخوا نفوذ لري، او دا کلمه عربي ریښې اَمَمَ څخه اخیستل شوې ده چې لار ښوول یا رهبري کول په معنی دی

modern_usage.modern_context: In the modern context, the term 'Eimam' is widely used to refer to a religious leader or spiritual guide in the Islamic community. Eimams provide guidance on religious matters, offer sermons and speeches, and engage in community outreach efforts. They are seen as authoritative figures and sources of knowledge, and their influence extends beyond traditional mosque settings. Social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram have become essential tools for Eimams to reach out to their followers, share insights, and build communities. Mobile applications, such as Islamic apps, Qibla finders, and daily prayer time calculators, provide Eimams with additional means to connect with their audience and offer guidance on a daily basis. Educational institutions, including Madrassas, Islamic schools, and universities, are also important venues where Eimams shape the next generation of Islamic leaders and scholars.
